narrative: A man said he was from a courier company and my parcel was stuck at customs. He asked me to pay a clearance fee by UPI.
Got a call that a package in my name was held at the airport and I had to pay customs duty immediately or face a police case.
Someone posing as a delivery agent said my shipment needed a small re-delivery charge, sent a payment link and took my money.
Received SMS about failed parcel delivery with a link. I paid the address update fee and then more money was taken.
Caller claimed to be from DHL and said a box with illegal items was booked using my Aadhaar. They demanded a fee to clear my name.
Courier executive told me my international gift parcel had customs tax pending and I transferred the amount to his account.
They said my courier contained drugs and a customs officer would arrest me unless I paid a verification charge immediately.
Parcel from abroad supposedly needed an import fee. The person on WhatsApp sent a QR code and I paid twice.
Fake logistics company message said delivery was on hold for a pending shipping charge; after paying, the number was switched off.
I was told a package addressed to me was seized at customs and I must pay a penalty online to release it.
Message said my bank KYC had expired and the account would be blocked today. I clicked the link and entered my OTP.
Caller pretending to be from the bank asked me to update my PAN details to avoid account suspension and took my OTP.
Got an SMS that my SIM KYC was incomplete. The executive made me install a screen sharing app and money left my account.
Someone said my net banking would be frozen unless I re-verified KYC through their link. After that unauthorised debits happened.
A person from customer care told me my debit card KYC was pending and asked for card number, expiry and the OTP.
Received a call about updating Aadhaar linking with my account. They sent a form link and emptied my savings.
Bank officer on phone said my account would be closed for incomplete KYC, made me share the code that came by SMS.
Link in message to complete e-KYC looked like my bank's site. I entered my login and lost money within minutes.
They claimed my wallet KYC verification failed and I had to pay a small fee and share OTP to reactivate it.
Phone call warned that my account was blocked due to KYC non-compliance; I followed their steps and money was transferred out.
I joined a Telegram group offering part-time work liking YouTube videos. After small payouts they asked me to deposit money for tasks.
Work from home job paid for rating hotels online. Later I had to prepay for premium tasks and could never withdraw.
A recruiter on WhatsApp offered daily income for simple online tasks. I invested to unlock higher tasks and lost everything.
Part-time job reviewing products required me to buy tasks first. They kept saying pay more to release my commission.
Got a job offer to like Instagram posts. After two small credits they asked for a deposit for a merchant task.
Online task job promised commission for completing orders. My balance showed profit but withdrawal needed more payment.
Telegram mentor said I must recharge my task account to continue earning. Each round asked for a bigger amount.
Home based job on an app for giving ratings. They froze my earnings until I paid a tax and a security deposit.
Message offered easy money for subscribing to channels; later they made me transfer funds for prepaid assignments.
I did data tasks for a company that paid first, then demanded I fund my wallet to finish a combination task.
An investment app promised double returns on crypto trading. My dashboard showed profit but I could not withdraw.
Stock market tips group convinced me to invest through their trading platform. When I asked to withdraw they wanted fees.
Advisor on WhatsApp said IPO allotment was guaranteed through their app. I transferred money and the app vanished.
Fake trading website showed huge gains on forex. To withdraw, they asked me to pay a tax deposit first.
Someone I met online taught me to trade on a platform that later blocked my account after I invested lakhs.
Group admin claimed to be from a brokerage and gave a link to an app for institutional trading. Money never came back.
Promised fixed high interest scheme through a mobile app. After the first returns they stopped responding.
Crypto mining investment showed daily earnings, but withdrawal required paying a verification fee repeatedly.
Stock tips mentor made me open an account on their trading app; profits were fake and they demanded commission.
Online investment platform said my capital was locked until I paid a service charge for account upgrade.
SMS said my electricity connection would be cut tonight because last month's bill was not updated. I called and paid.
Message from fake power department asked me to call an officer. He made me install an app and pay the pending bill.
Received warning that power supply will be disconnected at 9:30 pm; the number asked me to pay through a link.
Electricity board officer on phone said my bill payment failed and asked for a small payment to update it.
Text said my electricity would be cut due to unpaid dues. The caller took remote access of my phone.
They said my meter account was not updated and to avoid disconnection I should pay ten rupees, then my account was drained.
Fake bill update message with a phone number. Officer asked me to download a support app to clear dues.
I got a message about power cut tonight and paid the outstanding amount through the link they sent.
Caller claimed to be from the electricity department and threatened disconnection unless I paid immediately.
Message said consumer number blocked for non payment; following their instructions I lost money from my account.
I listed my sofa on OLX. A buyer said he was in the army and sent a QR code to receive money, but money was debited.
Buyer for my bike on an online marketplace asked me to scan a code to get advance payment and I lost money instead.
Someone interested in my old phone on OLX sent a payment request instead of paying, saying I must approve to receive.
Marketplace buyer claimed to be an army officer and asked me to send one rupee to verify, then took larger amounts.
While selling furniture online, the buyer sent a UPI collect request saying it was a refund. I entered PIN and lost money.
Fake buyer on classifieds wanted my laptop, sent QR to receive funds and my account got debited.
Selling a fridge on OLX, the buyer convinced me to pay a transfer charge to release his payment.
Buyer said he will pay via the army payment system and I needed to send money first for verification.
A person replying to my ad sent a link to receive payment; after entering my UPI PIN money went out.
OLX buyer asked me to scan a QR to get the amount for my camera, and the amount was deducted instead.
I took a small loan from an instant loan app. They charged huge fees and kept demanding more payments.
Loan app approved money without documents, then harassed me and my contacts to pay several times the amount.
Instant loan app recovery agents threatened to send morphed photos to my contacts unless I paid more.
I applied for a quick loan; they asked for processing fee and insurance charges but never gave the loan.
Loan app accessed my contacts and gallery and blackmailed me after I repaid the amount on time.
Got a pre-approved loan offer by SMS; paid advance processing charges and GST but no loan was disbursed.
Small loan app deducted heavy charges and gave a short repayment period, then extorted extra money with threats.
Online lender asked for a refundable security deposit before releasing the loan, then stopped answering.
Recovery agents from a loan app called my family and abused me to make me pay money I did not owe.
Quick cash loan app demanded repayment of double the amount within a week and threatened defamation.
Received a video call from an unknown woman; later they threatened to share a morphed video unless I paid.
A stranger on social media recorded our video call and demanded money to not send it to my family.
After a late night video call, I got threats that the clip would be uploaded unless I transferred money.
Someone pretending to be a police officer said there was a complaint about an obscene video and demanded a settlement.
Fake profile chatted with me, then blackmailed me with screenshots and a recorded call for money.
Unknown number video called me, then sent an edited video and asked for payment to delete it.
They threatened to post my private video on YouTube unless I paid; a fake cyber cell officer also called.
A woman added me on Instagram, video called, and the next day I received extortion messages.
After a WhatsApp video call, I was blackmailed with a recording and told to pay or it would go viral.
Caller said a girl had filed a complaint over our chat and asked money to close the case, threatening arrest.
I paid a contractor for house painting in advance and he never came back to finish the work.
Ordered a phone from an e-commerce site but received an empty box; the seller refuses refund.
My cousin borrowed money for a medical emergency and is not returning it despite promises.
Paid fees to a coaching institute that shut down a week later without returning any money.
A travel agent took payment for a holiday package and the hotel booking turned out not to exist.
I transferred rent to a landlord for a flat that was already rented to someone else.
Paid a used car dealer a deposit; the car had a different chassis number from the papers.
A wedding photographer took an advance and did not show up on the wedding day.
Gym membership was charged for a full year but the gym closed after two months.
Restaurant charged my card twice for one bill and the manager is not reversing it.
My debit card was swallowed by an ATM and the amount was debited without cash.
Paid a school admission donation to an agent who disappeared after collecting money.
Ordered furniture online and received a broken table; the company is ignoring complaints.
A friend sold me concert tickets that were rejected at the gate as duplicates.
Interior designer took payment for materials but used cheaper items than agreed.
Paid an astrologer for remedies after he promised results; nothing happened and he stopped calling.
